withdrawal.rulesBody: Once the feature ships: the withdrawal amount cannot exceed your available balance. When you submit the request, credits move to a payout_hold state and stay locked while the gateway reconciles. If the gateway rejects the payout, the held credits are returned to your wallet immediately.
